description.zh:
认证信息。
格式：Bearer ${access_token}。
示例：Bearer ATxxxx。
description.en:
The authentication information.
Format: Bearer ${access\_token}.
Example: Bearer ATxxxx.

title.zh: 获取应用同步范围信息

descriptions.zh: > - 同步范围在IDaaS控制台的应用管理中设置，创建应用之后，默认拥有此API的权限
descriptions.en: > - You can set the synchronization scope in Application Management in the IDaaS console. After you create an application, you have permission to call this API by default.
